record.source_episode: Approved KSU implementation/testing guidance; curated generated-model failure feedback. Golden inspection is diagnostic evaluation only, not newly approved training material.
record.trigger: Two conditional guarantees demand incompatible outputs for overlapping guards, or an English excerpt omits the environmental assumptions referenced by its terms.
record.principle: Before another code repair, replay the counterexample, classify implementation versus contract failure, and test whether conflicting guards can overlap. Trace each relevant environmental assumption to its full English source and assign the producer or system obligation that establishes it. Present missing dependencies for review rather than silently weakening guarantees or importing golden behavior.
record.semantic_choice: A counterexample admitted by the component precondition is meaningful even if the intended environment should forbid it. Conditional local proof does not discharge the environment assumption.
record.structural_placement: Data-preparation dependency ledger, reviewed English task, component assumptions and producer/system guarantee mapping.
record.repair_gate: Replay failed tests; show exact English/formal trace; test guard overlap; review any new assumption and updated English; rerun affected Verus/GUMBOX and producer/integration obligations. Stop after the user-configured checkpoint and preserve total attempts.
prerequisites: Exact failed artifact and tool evidence
Approved source context and explicit role separation
Human approval before proof-premise or English-scope revision
exclusions: Treating absence of a golden assumption as a tool limitation
Changing branch priority to hide contradictory guarantees
Adding assume/admit/external_body to suppress proof failures
Reclassifying a supported contradiction as an uncovered feature
Resetting attempts or budget after revision

counterexample.scenario: NORMAL mode, current98, lower99, upper97 satisfies both strict heat guards, demanding On and Off. The selected English lacks the ordering dependency.
counterexample.expected_difference: Ordering excludes this overlap conditionally; reviewing and discharging that premise is separate from code repair.

record.notes: Human-visible supervised development diagnosis, not independent transfer validation. EA-OI-6 wording and exact margin remain pending source review; no assumption is applied by this draft.
positive_paraphrases: implement the existing guarantee in the owning entry point
misleading_near_matches: a generated contract is an implemented behavior
